434: static int dispatch_locked(void)
435: {
436:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
437:   struct active_transaction *active;
438:   struct logical_channel *channel;
439:   unsigned int i;
440:   int ret;
441: 
442:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
443: 
444:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
445:     {
446:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
447:         {
448:           continue;
449:         }
450: 
451:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
452:       if (ret < 0)
453:         {
454:           return ret;
455:         }
456: 
457:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
458:     }
459: 
460:   if (g_reset_pending)
461:     {
462:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
463:       if (ret < 0)
464:         {
465:           return ret;
466:         }
467: 
468:       g_reset_pending = false;
469:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
470:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
471:     }
472: 
473:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
474:     {
475:       return OK;
476:     }
477: 
478:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
479:     {
480:       channel = &g_channels[i];
481:       if (!channel->queued)
482:         {
483:           continue;
484:         }
485: 
486:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
487:         {
488:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
489:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
490:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
491:             {
492:               continue;
493:             }
494: 
495:           active = &epoch->probe;
496:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
497:             {
498:               return -ENOLINK;
499:             }
500:         }
501:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
502:         {
503:           active = &g_active;
504:           if (active->quarantine)
505:             {
506:               return -ENOLINK;
507:             }
508:         }
509:       else
510:         {
511:           return OK;
512:         }
513: 
514:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
515:         {
516:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
517:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
518:                  sizeof(active->message));
519:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
520:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
521:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
522:             g_channel_ids[i]);
523:         }
524: 
525:       active->callback = channel->callback;
526:       active->arg = channel->arg;
527:       active->channel_index = i;
528:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();

532:           return ret;
533:         }

535:       active->busy = true;

541:             }

553: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
554:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
555: {
556:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
557: 
558:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
559:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
560:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
561:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
562:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
563:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
564:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
565: }

567: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
568: {
569:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
570:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
571:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;

574: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
575: {
576:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
577:   struct active_transaction *active;
578:   bool replay;
579:   int result;
580: 
581:   active = busy_probe();
582:   if (active == NULL)
583:     {
584:       active = &g_active;
585:     }
586: 
587:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
588:     {
589:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
590:       return;
591:     }
592: 
593:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
594:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
595:     {
596:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
597: 
598:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
599:       return;
600:     }
601: 
602:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
603:     {
604:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
605:       return;
606:     }
607: 
608:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
609:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
610: 
611:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
612:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
613:     {
614:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
615:     }
616: 
617:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
618:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
619:   if (replay)
620:     {
621:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
622:       unsigned int i;
623: 
624:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
625:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
626:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
627:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
628:        */
629: 
630:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
631:       g_active.quarantine = false;
632:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
633:         {
634:           if (i != replay_index)
635:             {
636:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
637:             }
638:         }
639: 
640:       select_recovery_epoch();
641:       (void)dispatch_locked();
642:       return;
643:     }
644: 
645:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
646: 
647:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
648:     {
649:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
650:         {
651:           release_recovery_slots();
652:           g_recovery_index = 0;
653:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
654:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
655:         }
656:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
657:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
658:         {
659:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
660:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
661:            */
662:         }
663:       else
664:         {
665:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
666:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
667:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
668:         }
669:     }
670: 
671:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
672:            result < 0)
673:     {
674:       begin_abort(result);
675:     }
676: 
677:   (void)dispatch_locked();
678: }

130:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
131:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
132:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
133:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
134:                                   BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);

138: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
139: {
140:   unsigned int i;
141: 
142:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
143:     {
144:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
145:         {
146:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
147:         }
148:     }
149: 
150:   return NULL;
151: }

153: static bool mbox_priority_message(
154:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
155: {
156:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
157: 
158:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
159: }

161: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
162: {
163:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
164:   unsigned int i;
165: 
166:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
167:     {
168:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
169: 
170:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
171:         {
172:           continue;
173:         }
174: 
175:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
176:         {
177:           oldest = desc;
178:         }
179:     }
180: 
181:   return oldest;
182: }

184: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
185: {
186:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
187:   int ret;
188: 
189:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
190:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
191:    */
192: 
193:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
194:     {
195:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
196:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
197:       g_processing_order = 0;
198:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
199:         {
200:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
201:           break;
202:         }
203: 
204:       desc->used = false;
205:     }
206: 
207:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
208:     {
209:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
210:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
211:       g_processing_order = 0;
212:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
213:         {
214:           break;
215:         }
216: 
217:       desc->used = false;
218:     }
219: }

221: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
222: {
223:   uintptr_t rdata0;
224:   uintptr_t rdata1;
225:   uintptr_t sidreg;
226:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
227:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
228: 
229:   (void)irq;
230:   (void)context;
231:   (void)arg;
232: 
233:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
234:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
235:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
236:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
237:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
238:     {
239:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
240:     }
241:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
242:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
243:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
244: 
245:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
246:     {
247:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
248:       uint32_t address;
249:       uint32_t length;
250:       uint8_t source;
251: 
252:       if (cpu == 0)
253:         {
254:           mbox_process_desc();
255:         }
256: 
257:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
258:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
259:         {
260:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
261:           break;
262:         }
263: 
264:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
265:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
266:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
267: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
268:       if (length == 0)
269:         {
270:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
271:             {
272:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
273:                 {
274:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
275:                 }
276: 
277:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
278:             }
279:           else
280:             {
281:               if (cpu == 0)
282:                 {
283:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
284:                 }
285:             }
286: 
287:           continue;
288:         }
289: #endif
290: 
291:       if (cpu != 0)
292:         {
293:           continue;
294:         }
295: 
296:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
297:         {
298:           continue;
299:         }
300: 
301:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
302:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
303:              sizeof(desc->message));
304:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
305:       desc->used = true;
306:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
307:       mbox_process_desc();
308:     }
309: 
310:   if (cpu == 0)
311:     {
312:       mbox_process_desc();
313:     }
314: 
315:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
316:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
317:     {
318:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
319:     }
320: 
321:   return OK;
322: }

324: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)

329: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)

337: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
338: {
339:   unsigned int i;
340: 
341:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
342:     {
343:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
344:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
345:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
346:         {
347:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
348:         }

352: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)

354:   irqstate_t flags;
355: 
356:   if (stats == NULL)
357:     {
358:       return;
359:     }
360: 
361:   flags = up_irq_save();
362:   *stats = g_stats;
363:   up_irq_restore(flags);
364: }

366: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
367: {
368:   int ret;
369: 
370:   if (g_mbox_ready)
371:     {
372:       return OK;
373:     }
374: 
375:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
376:   g_rx_order = 0;
377:   g_processing_order = 0;
378:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
379: 
380:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
381:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
382:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
383:    */
384: 
385:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
386:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
387:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
388:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
389: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
390:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
391:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
392:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
393:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
394: #endif
395:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
396:   mbox_clear_errors(0);
397: 
398:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
399:   if (ret < 0)
400:     {
401:       return ret;
402:     }
403: 
404:   g_mbox_ready = true;
405: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
406:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
407: #endif
408:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
409:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
410:   return OK;
411: }

414: {

417: #else
418:   return false;
419: #endif

169: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
170:                                 int result, void *arg)

186:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;

192:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
193:     }
194: 
195:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
196:     {
197:       if (!failed)
198:         {
199:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
200:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
201:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
202:         }
203:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)

210:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
211:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
212:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
213:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
214:         }
215:       else
216:         {
217:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
218:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
219:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
220:             {
221:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
222:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
223:                */
224: 
225:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
226:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
227:             }
228:           else
229:             {

231:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
232:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
233:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;

235:         }
236:

302:           malformed = true;
303:         }
304:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
305:         {
306:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
307:           failed = true;
308:           malformed = true;
309:         }
310:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())

312:           failed = true;
313:         }
314:       else if (rx_free() < length)

316:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;

320:       else

322:           const uint8_t *source =

329:               first = length;
330:             }

332:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);

338:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;

342:     }
343:   else if (!failed)
344:     {
345:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
346:         {
347:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
348:           failed = true;
349:           malformed = true;
350:         }
351:       else
352:         {
353:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
354:         }
355:     }
356: 
357:   if (!malformed)

359:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;

227: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
228: {
229: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
230: 
231: 	while (1)
232: 	{
233: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
234: 		bk_err_t ret;
235: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
236: 
237: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
238: 		{
239: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
240: 			return;
241: 		}
242: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
243: 		ack_sending = 1;
244: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
245: 
246: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
247: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
248: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
249: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
250: 		{
251: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
252: 			ack_sending = 0;
253: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
254: 			return;
255: 		}
256: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
257: 		ack_count--;
258: 		ack_sending = 0;
259: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
260: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
261: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
262: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],

331: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
332: {
333: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
334: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
335: 	u16 			chnl_type;
336: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
337: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
338: 
339: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
340: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
341: 
342: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
343: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
344: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
345: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
346: #endif
347: 
348: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
349: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
350: 
351: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
352: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
353: 
354: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
355: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
356: 
357: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
358: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
359: 
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
361: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
362: 
363: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
364: 
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
367: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
368: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
369: 
370: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
371: 
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
373: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
374: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
375: 
376: 	__DMB();
377: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
378: 
379: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
380: 
381: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
382: 
383: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
384: 	{
385: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
386: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
387: 
388: 		return ret_code;
389: 	}
390: 
391: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
392: 
393: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
394: 
395: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
396: 	{
397: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
398: 	}
399: 
400: 	return BK_OK;
401: }

403: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
404: {
405: 	u8		log_chnl;
406: 	u8		ret_code;
407: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
408: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
409: 
410: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
411: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
412: 
413: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
414: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
415: 	{
416: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
417: 
418: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
419: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
420: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
421: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
422: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
423: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
424: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
425: 		{
426: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
427: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
428: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
429: 			return;
430: 		}
431: 
432: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
433: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
434: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
435: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
436: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
437: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
438: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
439: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
440: 		{
441: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
442: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
443: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
444: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
445: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
446: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
447: 			{
448: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
449: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
450: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
451: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
452: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
453: 			}
454: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
455: 		}
456: 		else
457: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
458: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
459: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
460: 		return;
461: 	}
462: 
463: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
464: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
465: 
466: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
467: 
468: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
469: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
470: 		return;
471: 	}
472: 
473: 
474: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
475: 	{
476: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
477: 		return;
478: 	}
479: 
480: 
481: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
482: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
483: 		return;
484: 	}
485: 
486: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
487: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
488: 
489: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
490: 	{
491: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
492: 		return;
493: 	}
494: 
495: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
496: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
497: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
498: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
499: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
500: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
501: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
502: 	{
503: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
504: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
505: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
506: 		return;
507: 	}
508: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
509: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
510: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
511: 
512: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
513: 
514: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
515: 	{
516: 		/* clear following header members. */
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
518: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
519: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
520: 
521: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
522: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
523: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
524: 	} else {
525: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
526: 	}
527: 
528: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
529: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
530: 	{
531: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
532: 		return;
533: 	}
534: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
535: 	{
536: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
537: 			break;
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
541: 	{
542: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
543: 		return;
544: 	}
545: 
546: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
547: 
548: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
549: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
550: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
551: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
552: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
553: 
554: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
555: 
556: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
557: 	{
558: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
559: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
560: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
561: 	}
562: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
563: 
564: 	return;
565: 
566: }

568: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
569: {
570: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
571: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
572: 
573: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
574: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
575: 
576: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
577: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
578: 
579: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
580: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
581: 
582: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
583: 
584: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
585: 		return;
586: 
587: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
588: 		return;
589: 
590: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
591: 		return;
592: 
593: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
594: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
595: 
596: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
597: 
598: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
599: 	{
600: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
601: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
602: 
603: 		return;
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
607: 	{
608: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
611: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
612: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
613: 
614: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
615: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
616: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
617: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
618: 	}
619: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
620: 	{
621: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
622: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
623: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
624: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
625: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
626: 
627: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
628: 
629: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
630: 	}
631: 	else
632: 	{
633: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
634: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
635: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
636: 	}
637: 
638: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
639: 	{
640: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
641: 		return;
642: 	}
643: 
644: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
645: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
646: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
647: 
648: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
649: 	{
650: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
651: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
652: 		return;
653: 	}
654: 	return;
655: }

657: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
658: {
659: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
660: 
661: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
662: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
663: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
664: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
665: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
666: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
667: 
668: 	/*
669: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
670: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
671: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
672: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
673: 	 */
674: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
675: 	{
676: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
677: 	}
678: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
679: 	{
680: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
681: 	}
682: }

684: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
685: {
686: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
687: 
688: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
689: 
690: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
691: 
692: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
693: 
694: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
695: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
696: 
697: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
698: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
699: 
700: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
701: 
702: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
703: 	{
704: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
705: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
706: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
707: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
708: 
709: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
710: 
711: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
712: 		{
713: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
714: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
715: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
716: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
717: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
718: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
719: 
720: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
721: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
722: 			}
723: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
724: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
725: 			return ret_code;
726: 		}
727: 	}
728: 
729: 	return BK_OK;
730: }

732: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
733: 
734: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
735: {
736: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
737: 	u16 			chnl_type;
738: 
739: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
740: 
741: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
742: 
743: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
744: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
745: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
746: #endif
747: 
748: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
749: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
750: 
751: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
752: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
753: 
754: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
755: 
756: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
757: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
758: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
759: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
760: 
761: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
762: 
763: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
764: 
765: 	/*
766: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
767: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
768: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
769: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
770: 	 */
771: 	while(1)
772: 	{
773: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
774: 
775: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
776: 		{
777: 			break;
778: 		}
779: 	}
780: 
781: 	return ret_code;
782: }

785: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
786: /*
787:   * init logical chnanel module.
788:   * return:
789:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
790:   *     failed  : fail code.
791:   *
792:   */
793: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
794: {
795: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
796: 	int				i, j;
797: 
798: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
799: 
800: 	/*
801: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
802: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
803: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
804: 	 * can race here:
805: 	 *
806: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
807: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
808: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
809: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
810: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
811: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
812: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
813: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
814: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
815: 	 *
816: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
817: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
818: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
819: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
820: 	 */
821: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
822: 	{
823: 		return BK_OK;
824: 	}
825: 
826: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
827: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
828: 	{
829: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
830: 		return BK_OK;
831: 	}
832: 
833: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
834: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
835: 	ack_read = 0;
836: 	ack_write = 0;
837: 	ack_count = 0;
838: 	ack_sending = 0;
839: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
840: 	{
841: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
842: 
843: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
844: 
845: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
846: 
847: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
848: 		{
849: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
850: 		}
851: 	}
852: 
853: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
854: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
855: 	{
856: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
857: 		return ret_code;
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
861: 
862: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
863: 	{
864: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
865: 
866: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
867: 	}
868: 
869: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
870: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
871: 
872: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
873: 
874: 	return BK_OK;

1148: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1149: {
1150: 	u8 phy_idx;
1151: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1152: 
1153: 	/* The CPU1 boot transaction may poll directly while ap_console is also
1154: 	 * scheduled.  Serialize the whole poll pass without holding the channel
1155: 	 * lock across callbacks and physical sends.
1156: 	 */
1157: 	if (s_poll_active)
1158: 	{
1159: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1160: 		return;
1161: 	}
1162: 	s_poll_active = 1;
1163: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1164: 
1165: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1166: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1167: 
1168: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1169: 	{
1170: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1171: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1172: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1173: 		u8 log_idx;
1174: 
1175: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1176: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1177: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1178: 		{
1179: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1180: 			continue;
1181: 		}
1182: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1183: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1184: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1185: 
1186: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1187: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1188: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1189: 			continue;
1190: 
1191: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1192: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1193: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1194: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1195: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1196: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1197: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1198: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1199: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1200: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1201: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1202: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1203: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1204: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1205: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1206: 		else
1207: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1208: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1209: 	}
1210: 
1211: 	poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1212: 	s_poll_active = 0;
1213: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1214: }

57: static void mbox0_reap_slots(u8 dst)
58: {
59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* ACK slots are released only by a later command ACK fence.  FIFO empty
91: 	 * alone does not prove that the peer finished copying the pointed data.
92: 	 */
93: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
94: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
95: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
96: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
97: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
98: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
99: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;

203: void bk_mailbox_poll(void)

242: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);

244: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();

246: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);

250: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
251: {
252: 	u32 address;
253: 	u32 source;
254: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
255: 	u8 i;
256: 
257: 	if (!msg)
258: 		return;
259: 
260: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
261: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
262: 	{
263: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
264: 		return;
265: 	}
266: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
267: 	{
268: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
269: 		return;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	address = msg->data[0];
273: 	if (address & 0x3u)
274: 	{
275: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
276: 		return;
277: 	}
278: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
279: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
280: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
281: 	{
282: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
283: 		return;
284: 	}
285: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
286: 	{
287: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
288: 		return;
289: 	}
290: 
291: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
292: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
293: #endif
294: 	__DMB();
295: 	desc = NULL;
296: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
297: 	{
298: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
299: 		{
300: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
301: 			break;
302: 		}
303: 	}
304: 	if (!desc)
305: 	{
306: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
307: 		return;
308: 	}
309: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
310: 	desc->source = source;
311: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
312: 	desc->used = 1;
313: 	rx_count++;
314: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
315:

1: #include "sdkconfig.h"

10:

13: #define MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START     (MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START + MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN)
14: #define MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_START     (MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START + MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN)

16: //struct mbox0_fifo_cfg_t:
17: #define MBOX0_FIFO_CFG_TABLE   \
18: {   \
19: 	{MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN0_FIFO_LEN}, \
20: 	{MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN1_FIFO_LEN}, \
21: 	{MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_START, MBOX0_CHN2_FIFO_LEN}, \
22: }

25: static u8                mbox0_init = 0;

27: static const mbox0_fifo_cfg_t  fifo_cfg[] = MBOX0_FIFO_CFG_TABLE;

29: static int mbox0_drv_recieve_message(mbox0_message_t* message)
30: {
31: 	return mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_recv(&mbox0_dev.hal, message);
32: }
33: 
34: static void mbox0_drv_isr_handler(void)
35: {
36: 	uint32_t int_status;
37: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
38: 	mbox0_message_t message;
39: 
40: 	int_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_get_int_status(&mbox0_dev.hal);
41: 
42: 	if(int_status == 0)
43: 		return;
44: 
45: 	do
46: 	{
47: 		fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[SELF_CHNL]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
48: 
49: 		if(fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_NOT_EMPTY)
50: 		{
51: 			if (mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback &&
52: 				!mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback())
53: 				break;
54: 
55: 			mbox0_drv_recieve_message(&message);
56: 
57: 			if(message.data[1] != 0)  /* message data len is not 0. */
58: 			{
59: 				if(mbox0_dev.rx_callback != NULL)
60: 					mbox0_dev.rx_callback(&message);
61: 			}
62: 			else
63: 			{
64: 				#if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
65: 				extern void crosscore_smp_cmd_handler(uint8_t src_core, uint32_t cmd);
66: 
67: 				crosscore_smp_cmd_handler(message.src_cpu, message.data[0]);
68: 				#endif
69: 			}
70: 		}
71: 		else
72: 		{
73: 			break;
74: 		}
75: 	} while(1);
76: 
77: }

82: }

124: int mbox0_init_on_current_core(int id)
125: {
126: 	int int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
127: 
128: 	if(CPU0_CORE_ID == id)
129: 	{
130: 		mbox0_hal_dev_init(&mbox0_dev.hal);  /* can only be initialized by CPU0. */
131: 		mbox0_hal_set_reg_0x2_chn_pro_disable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 1); /* channel unprotect */
132: 
133: 		for(int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(fifo_cfg); i++)
134: 			mbox0_dev.chn_drv[i]->chn_cfg_fifo(&mbox0_dev.hal, fifo_cfg[i].start, fifo_cfg[i].len);
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[id]->chn_int_enable(&mbox0_dev.hal, 1);
138: 
139: 	/* clear/empty RX FIFO. */
140: 	while(1)
141: 	{
142: 		mbox0_message_t message;
143: 
144: 		uint32_t fifo_status = mbox0_dev.chn_drv[id]->chn_get_rx_fifo_stat(&mbox0_dev.hal);
145: 
146: 		if(fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_NOT_EMPTY)
147: 		{
148: 			mbox0_drv_recieve_message(&message);
149: 		}
150: 		else
151: 		{
152: 			break;
153: 		}
154: 	}
155: 
156: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
157: 	/* enable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
158: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_enable(id, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
159: #else
160: 	sys_drv_int_group2_enable(1 << (int_src - 32));
161: #endif
162: 
163: 	return 0;
164: }

166: int mbox0_drv_init(void)
167: {
168: 	if(mbox0_init == 1)
169: 		return 0;
170: 
171: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[0] = &hal_chn0_drv;
172: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[1] = &hal_chn1_drv;
173: 	mbox0_dev.chn_drv[2] = &hal_chn2_drv;
174: 
175: 	mbox0_dev.rx_callback = NULL;
176: 	mbox0_dev.rx_ready_callback = NULL;
177: 
178: 	mbox0_hal_init(&mbox0_dev.hal);
179: 
180: 	int int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
181: 
182: 	bk_int_isr_register(int_src, mbox0_drv_isr_handler, NULL);
183: 
184: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
185: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(CPU0_CORE_ID);
186: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(CPU1_CORE_ID);
187: #else
188: 	mbox0_init_on_current_core(SELF_CHNL);
189: #endif
190: 
191: 	mbox0_init = 1;
192: 
193: 	return 0;
194: }

196: int mbox0_drv_deinit(void)
197: {
198: 	if(mbox0_init == 0)
199: 		return 0;
200: 
201: 	uint8_t int_src = INT_SRC_MAILBOX;
202: 
203: 	// sys_drv_int_group2_disable(1 << (int_src - 32));
204: 
205: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
206: 	/* disable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */
207: 	sys_drv_core_intr_group2_disable(CPU0_CORE_ID, (1 << (int_src - 32)));
208: 
209: 	/* disable system interrupt, every channel is hard-bound to a processor */

369: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
370: {
371:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
372:   struct pwc_message message;
373:   unsigned int next;
374:   irqstate_t flags;
375: 
376:   if (bytes == NULL)
377:     {
378:       return;
379:     }
380: 
381:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
382:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
383:   if (next == g_tail)
384:     {
385:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
386:       return;
387:     }
388: 
389:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
390:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
391:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
392:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
393:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
394:   g_head = next;
395:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
396:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);

399: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)

402: 
403:   (void)argc;
404:   (void)argv;

406:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
407:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;

410:     {
411:       return -EXDEV;

414:   for (;;)
415:     {
416:       struct pwc_message message;
417:       irqstate_t flags;
418: 
419:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
420:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
421:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
422:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
423:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);

426:         {
427:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:

434:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
435:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
436:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
437:               }
438:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);

441:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
442:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);

444:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)

447:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
448:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
449:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
450:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
451:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
452:               }
453:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
454:             break;
455: 
456: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
457:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
458:             if (message.param1 == 0u)

474:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();

478:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
479:             bk7258_psram_dump();
480:             break;
481: 
482:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
483:             {
484: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
485:               ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
486:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
487:                       (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
488: #else
489:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
490: 
491:               ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
492:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
493:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
494:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,

122: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
123: {
124: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
125: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
126: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
127: 
128: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
129: 
130: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
131: 	{
132: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
133: 		{
134: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
135: 		}
136: 
137: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
138: 		{
139: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
140: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
141: 		}
142: 
143: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
144: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
145: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
146: 
147: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
148: 
149: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
150: 		{
151: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
152: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
153: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
154: 		}
155: 		else
156: 		{
157: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
158: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
159: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
160: 			{
161: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
162: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
163: 				#endif
164: 				__DMB();
165: 				
166: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
167: 
168: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
169: 			}
170: 			else
171: 			{
172: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
173: 			}
174: 		}
175: 
176: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
177: 
178: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
179: 
180: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
181: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
182: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
183: 
184: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
185: 
186: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
187: 	}
188: 	else
189: 	{
190: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
191: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
192: 
193: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
194: 
195: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
196: 		{
197: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
198: 		}
199: 		else
200: 		{
201: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
202: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
203: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
204: 			{
205: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
206: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
207: 				#endif
208: 				__DMB();
209: 				
210: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
211: 
212: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
217: 			}
218: 
219: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
220: 		}
221: 
222: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
223: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
224: 	}
225: 
226: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
227: 
228: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
229: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
230: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
231: 	 */
232: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
233: 
234: 	return;
235: 
236: }

238: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
239: {
240: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
241: 	{
242: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
243: 			return;
244: 
245: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
246: 
247: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
248: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
249: 		{
250: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
251: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
252: 
253: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
254: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
255: 		}
256: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
257: 		{
258: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
259: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
260: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
261: 
262: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
263: 
264: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
265: 
266: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
267: 			{
268: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
269: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
270: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
271: 			}
272: 			else
273: 			{
274: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
275: 				{
276: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
277: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
278: 					#endif
279: 					__DMB();
280: 
281: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
282: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
283: 				}
284: 				else
285: 				{
286: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 			
290: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
291: 		}
292: 		else
293: 		{
294: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
295: 		}
296: 
297: 		return;
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	/*
301: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
302: 	 */
303: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
304: 
305: 	return;
306: 
307: }

309: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
310: {
311: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
312: 
313: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
314: 		return BK_OK;
315: 
316: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
317: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
318: 
319: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
320: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
321: 
322: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
323: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
324: 	{
325: 		return BK_FAIL;
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
329: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
330: 	{
331: 		return ret_code;
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
335: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
336: 	{
337: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
338: 
339: 		return ret_code;
340: 	}
341: 
342: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
343: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
344: 	{
345: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
346: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
347: 
348: 		return ret_code;
349: 	}
350: 
351: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
352: 
353: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
354: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
355: 
356: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
357: 
358: 	return BK_OK;
359: }

361: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
362: {
363: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
364: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
365: 
366: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
367: 		ipc_init();
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
371: 		return BK_FAIL;
372: 
373: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
374: 
375: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
376: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
377: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
378: 
379: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
380: 
381: 	do
382: 	{
383: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
384: 		{
385: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
386: 			break;
387: 		}
388: 
389: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
390: 			cmd_len = 0;
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
393: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
394: 
395: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
396: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
397: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
398: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
399: 
400: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
401: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
402: 		{
403: 			break;
404: 		}
405: 
406: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
407: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
408: 		{
409: 			break;
410: 		}
411: 
412: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
413: 
414: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
415: 		{
416: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
417: 			break;
418: 		}
419: 
420: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
421: 		{
422: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
423: 			break;
424: 		}
425: 
426: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
427: 		{
428: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
429: 			break;
430: 		}
431: 
432: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
433: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
434: 
435: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
436: 
437: 	}while(0);
438: 
439: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
440: 
441: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
442: 
443: 	return ret_val;
444: 
445: }

447: static bk_err_t ipc_send_special_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd)
448: {
449: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
450: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
451: 
452: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
453: 		ipc_init();
454: 	}
455: 
456: 	if (!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)

94: 
95: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)

108: 	}

166: 
167: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)

169: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
170: 		return;

172: 
173: 	while(1)
174: 	{
175: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
176: 
177: 		if(events == 0)

181: 		}

183: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
184: 		{

190: 		
191: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
192: 		{
193: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
194: 
195: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
196: 			{

198: 				
199: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
200: 				{
201: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
202: 					{
203: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
204: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
205: 					}
206: 				}
207: 				else
208: 				{
209: 					if(retry_cnt > 0)
210: 					{
211: 						BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC retry to start core%d\r\n", cpu_x_id);
212: 						// restart_cpu_x();
213: 						break;
214: 					}
215: 					else
216: 					{
217: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
218: 					}
219: 				}
220: 
221: 				retry_cnt++;
222: 			}
223: 
224: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
225: 		}
226: 		
227: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
228: 		{
229: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
230: 			{
231: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC heartbeat timeout%d\r\n", cpu_x_id);

233: 				BK_ASSERT(false);

235: 			}
236: 		}
237: 
238: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
239: 		{

242: 		else
243: 		{

1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP移植
2: 
3: 本项目将OpenVela/NuttX移植到BK7258 AP核，并保留博通原厂CP固件、Bootloader、分区和最终打包流程。当前已实现AP核启动，以及AP日志通过Mailbox转发到CP UART0输出。
4: 
5: ## 简单使用说明
6: 
7: 本项目需要配合博通`bk_avdk_smp` SMP工程使用：
8: 
9: ```text
10: 工作区/
11: ├── contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12: └── bk_avdk_smp/
13: ```
14: 
15: 构建前，需要将比赛仓`external/bk_avdk_smp/`中的权威覆盖文件同步到
16: `bk_avdk_smp`。完整文件清单、可直接执行的同步脚本、逐字节校验、OpenVela AP
17: 构建、CP构建和最终固件打包步骤见`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。Git协作和
18: 提交规则见`github开发指南.md`。
19: 
20: ## UART0控制台使用
21: 
22: 连接开发板UART0：
23: 
24: ```bash
25: picocom --no-escape -b 115200 --flow n --parity n --databits 8 /dev/ttyUSB0
26: ```
27: 
28: CP启动后可先查看AP链路状态，再进入AP的OpenVela NSH控制台：
29: 
30: ```text
31: ap_console status
32: ap_console open
33: ```
34: 
35: 进入AP控制台后可以直接执行NSH命令，例如：
36: 
37: ```text
38: help
39: uname -a

489:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
490:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
491:             {
492:               continue;
493:             }
494: 
495:           active = &epoch->probe;
496:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
497:             {
498:               return -ENOLINK;
499:             }
500:         }
501:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
502:         {
503:           active = &g_active;
504:           if (active->quarantine)
505:             {
506:               return -ENOLINK;
507:             }
508:         }
509:       else
510:         {
511:           return OK;
512:         }
513: 
514:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
515:         {
516:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
517:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
518:                  sizeof(active->message));
519:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
520:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
521:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
522:             g_channel_ids[i]);
523:         }
524: 
525:       active->callback = channel->callback;
526:       active->arg = channel->arg;
527:       active->channel_index = i;
528:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
529:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
530:       if (ret < 0)
531:         {
532:           return ret;
533:         }
534: 
535:       active->busy = true;
536:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
537:         {
538:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
539:             {
540:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
541:             }
542: 
543:           g_probe_attempts++;
544:           g_stats.probes++;
545:         }
546: 
547:       return OK;
548:     }
549: 
550:   return OK;
551: }
552: 
553: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
554:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
555: {
556:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
557: 
558:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
559:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
560:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
561:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
562:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
563:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
564:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
565: }
566: 
567: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
568: {
569:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
570:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
571:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
572: }
573: 
574: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
575: {
576:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
577:   struct active_transaction *active;
578:   bool replay;
579:   int result;
580: 
581:   active = busy_probe();
582:   if (active == NULL)
583:     {
584:       active = &g_active;
585:     }
586: 
587:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
588:     {
589:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
590:       return;
591:     }
592: 
593:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
594:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
595:     {
596:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
597: 
598:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
599:       return;
600:     }
601: 
602:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
603:     {
604:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
605:       return;
606:     }
607: 
608:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
609:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
610: 
611:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
612:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
613:     {
614:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
615:     }
616: 
617:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
618:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
619:   if (replay)
620:     {
621:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
622:       unsigned int i;
623: 
624:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
625:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
626:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
627:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
628:        */
629: 
630:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
631:       g_active.quarantine = false;
632:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
633:         {
634:           if (i != replay_index)
635:             {
636:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
637:             }
638:         }
639: 
640:       select_recovery_epoch();
641:       (void)dispatch_locked();
642:       return;
643:     }
644: 
645:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
646: 
647:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
648:     {
649:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
650:         {
651:           release_recovery_slots();
652:           g_recovery_index = 0;
653:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
654:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
655:         }
656:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
657:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
658:         {
659:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
660:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
661:            */
662:         }
663:       else
664:         {
665:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
666:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
667:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
668:         }
669:     }
670: 
671:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
672:            result < 0)
673:     {
674:       begin_abort(result);
675:     }
676: 
677:   (void)dispatch_locked();
678: }

680: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
681: {
682:   struct ack_slot *slot;
683:   unsigned int rx_index;
684:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
685:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
686:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
687:   uint8_t state = 0;
688:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
689: 
690:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
691:     {
692:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
693:       if (slot == NULL)
694:         {
695:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
696:           return -EAGAIN;
697:         }
698:     }
699:   else
700:     {
701:       slot = NULL;
702:     }
703: 
704:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
705:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
706:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
707:     {
708:       g_stats.bad_header++;
709:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
710:     }
711:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
712:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
713:     {
714:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
715:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
716:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
717:         {
718:           if (slot != NULL)
719:             {
720:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
721:             }
722: 
723:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
724:           return -EAGAIN;
725:         }
726:       else if (ret < 0)
727:         {
728:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
729:         }
730:     }
731:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
732:     {
733:       g_pwc_rx(message);
734:       ret = OK;
735:     }
736:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
737:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
738:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
739:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
740:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
741:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
742:     {
743:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
744:       ack_flags = 2u;
745:       ret = OK;
746:     }
747:   else
748:     {
749:       g_stats.unsupported++;
750:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
751:     }
752: 
753:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
754:     {
755:       return OK;
756:     }
757: 
758:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
759:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
760:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
761:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
762:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
763: 
764:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
765:     {
766:       g_probe_requested = true;
767:     }
768: 
769:   (void)dispatch_locked();
770:   return OK;
771: }

163:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;

184: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
185: {
186:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
187:   int ret;
188: 
189:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
190:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
191:    */
192: 
193:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
194:     {
195:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
196:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
197:       g_processing_order = 0;
198:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
199:         {
200:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
201:           break;
202:         }
203: 
204:       desc->used = false;
205:     }
206: 
207:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
208:     {
209:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
210:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
211:       g_processing_order = 0;
212:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
213:         {
214:           break;
215:         }
216: 
217:       desc->used = false;
218:     }

221: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
222: {
223:   uintptr_t rdata0;
224:   uintptr_t rdata1;
225:   uintptr_t sidreg;
226:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
227:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
228: 
229:   (void)irq;
230:   (void)context;
231:   (void)arg;
232: 
233:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
234:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
235:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
236:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
237:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
238:     {
239:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
240:     }
241:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
242:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
243:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
244: 
245:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
246:     {
247:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
248:       uint32_t address;
249:       uint32_t length;
250:       uint8_t source;
251: 
252:       if (cpu == 0)
253:         {
254:           mbox_process_desc();
255:         }
256: 
257:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
258:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
259:         {
260:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
261:           break;
262:         }
263: 
264:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
265:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
266:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
267: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
268:       if (length == 0)
269:         {
270:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
271:             {
272:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
273:                 {
274:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
275:                 }
276: 
277:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
278:             }
279:           else
280:             {
281:               if (cpu == 0)
282:                 {
283:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
284:                 }
285:             }
286: 
287:           continue;
288:         }
289: #endif
290: 
291:       if (cpu != 0)
292:         {
293:           continue;
294:         }
295: 
296:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
297:         {
298:           continue;
299:         }
300: 
301:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
302:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
303:              sizeof(desc->message));
304:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
305:       desc->used = true;
306:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
307:       mbox_process_desc();
308:     }
309: 
310:   if (cpu == 0)
311:     {
312:       mbox_process_desc();
313:     }
314: 
315:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
316:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
317:     {
318:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
319:     }
320: 
321:   return OK;
322: }

187: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
188: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
189: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
190: 	
191: 	return ret_code;
192: }

194: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
195: {
196: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
197: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
198: 	u16 			chnl_type;
199: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
200: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
201: 
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
203: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
204: 
205: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
206: 		return 4;
207: 
208: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
209: 		return 5;
210: 
211: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
212: 		return 3;
213: 
214: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }

259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }
